sources.researchNote: The distributor-supplied description gives the digital release date as 5 February 2013 and separately dates YouTube publication to 11 February 2015. It names Paul O’Montis, the Paul Godwin Orchestra and conductor Paul Godwin, but identifies no original disc label, catalogue number, matrix or exact session. The album’s 1929–1936 span is not the date of this individual recording. The structured date describes the digital issue only.
